data.notes: Only one clearly confirmed July 2027 music festival very near Antwerp was found at this stage; major Antwerp-area club and arena calendars had not yet posted July 2027 music dates.

events.title: Sfinks Mixed 2027
events.summary: Sfinks Mixed is confirmed for 29 July–1 August 2027 in Boechout, just outside Antwerp, with free entrance. The festival presents four days of music and culture from around the world; the detailed 2027 artist lineup was not yet published on the official site at time of research.

events.title: Tendance Festival
events.summary: Antwerp-area outdoor DJ festival in Kapellen with a confirmed 2027 date; previous/adjacent listings position it in the techno, house and classics lane, but the 2027 line-up is not yet published.
